title: Treating Burns Cuts Fractures
description: Covers classifying and treating burns, cleaning cuts, deciding when stitches are needed, and closing wounds without them. Includes telling fractures from sprains, splinting, circulation checks, sling and swathe, drug-free pain management, and when to seek help.
shortDescription: Burn degrees, wound cleaning and closure, splints, and slings
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
